story: Azhar Shafi, 32, from Kazhakkottam, was seriously injured in a road accident in Marthandam on 22 October 2026.
He is in the ICU at Ananthapuri Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram, with a severe head injury and bleeding in the brain.
On the morning of the accident, he was travelling from Nagercoil to Thiruvananthapuram when his vehicle went out of control and struck the rear of a lorry parked by the roadside.

volunteer.heading: Take a step for Azhar
volunteer.intro: As an interim option while UPI and GPay are unavailable, you can volunteer to collect cash contributions locally.
steps: Deposit the collected cash into your own bank account.
Transfer the combined amount from your account by NEFT to any one of the three accounts below.
volunteer.whatsappText: During this interim period, volunteers can collect cash contributions, deposit the cash into their own bank account, then transfer the combined amount by NEFT from that account to any one of the accounts below.
posterLines: Collect cash contributions locally for now.
Deposit the cash into your own bank account.
Transfer the total by NEFT to any account below.
